purpose: Functional review verification with an isolated profile; not human animation approval
checks: All123 gesture rows begin unchecked and count as failed in an isolated profile
Checking Nod records pass and safe text notes without sending any motion command
Family/search/pass-fail filtering preserves each animation's review and notes
Space toggles the focused native review checkbox without playing a gesture
Next advances the selected animation without autoplay
Browser reload restores saved review status and notes
Actual browser JSON download contains all123 animations even when only Passed is visible
Import restores saved reviews; malformed import rejects atomically without changing saved data
Mobile review controls remain within a390px viewport
